messages.subject: Authentication - get username inside server.R
parts: Is it possible to get the username of the person inside server.R? It would be extremely useful to be able to filter the data by username when multiple users exist.

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Authentication - get username inside server.R
parts:
Yes. The username is available via the session parameter in shiny 0.8 and later. For example you can access the username as such:

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  output$username <- reactive({
    session$user
  )
})


-Andy
